questions.question: Is each supplied short link the product you intend?
questions.answer: Each supplied short link resolves to an amazon.com listing (observed 2026-11-20). Whether that listing is the intended product is not known, because no intended ASIN was given.
questions.how_to_discover: Requester confirms the intended ASIN or listing for each of the five products.

questions.question: Do the supplied short links track correctly and comply with the Associates rules?
questions.answer: Unresolved. Commission Income Statement s.2(e) and s.2(g) describe the risks (S-02). The request asks that this not be asserted either way.
questions.how_to_discover: Run one Special Link per product in Associates Central and compare the tracking report with the supplied link.

questions.question: Is the supplied tracking ID valid for this account?
questions.answer: Not checked. The format differs from the documented 'XXXXX-##' pattern (S-02, s.2(b)).
questions.how_to_discover: Open Associates Central and look up the tracking ID in the tracking-ID list.

questions.question: What commission rate applies to each category?
questions.answer: Not available. The schedule page requires sign-in (S-03).
questions.how_to_discover: Read the commission schedule while signed in to Associates Central; record the date and page.

questions.question: What are current prices and availability?
questions.answer: Not captured. Amazon-served or PA API data is the only permitted price source (S-02, s.2(b)).
questions.how_to_discover: Decide on a price method (Suggestions S-01) and capture only from that source.

questions.question: Are the five analytics events (page_view, outbound_click, guide_engaged, disclosure_view, affiliate_conversion_reported) the right ones?
questions.answer: Defined in the client's header by an earlier session (assets/counterwise.js). The request did not list them, so the requester has not confirmed them.
questions.how_to_discover: Requester confirms or replaces the five events, with trigger and properties.

questions.question: Where should the click counter and analytics endpoint run?
questions.answer: This static site cannot run them. GitHub Pages serves files only (S-07).

questions.question: Which topic should be written next?
questions.answer: No measured query or click data exists yet. The four working titles carry no demand evidence.
questions.how_to_discover: Collect first-party analytics and Search Console query data for at least one publishing cycle.

questions.question: Is the Associates disclosure placed clearly and prominently enough?
questions.answer: The Section 5 sentence matches S-01 verbatim and is shown above the fold on every page and in the footer. Reviewer judgment is still needed.
questions.how_to_discover: Reviewer checks the live pages against S-01 and S-05.

questions.question: Who is the author, and what is the brand name?
questions.how_to_discover: Requester provides the byline and brand decision.

questions.question: Are the seller certification claims in the listings accurate?
questions.answer: Not checked. P-04 lists 'NIST&NSF Certified' as a title claim only.
questions.how_to_discover: Check the certifying body's own registry for each named certificate.

questions.question: Is the site indexed, and does it rank for any query?
questions.answer: Not checked. The site has not been submitted to Search Console.
questions.how_to_discover: Verify the property in Search Console and check coverage after the first deploy.
